observedChecks.name: Actual readability
observedChecks.observation: Chinese body glyphs, English serif prose, blue question numbers and uppercase option labels are readable at original detail. Long stems and wrapped options remain distinguishable with adequate line spacing and contrast. No observed unreadable, blank, replacement-box or corrupted text.

observedChecks.name: Labels and visible text binding
observedChecks.observation: Titles read 练习 14 - 选择题 and Exercise 14 - Choices. Observed stems and options correspond to the permitted visible-only arrays within the exact scope above. Displayed A-D/A-E letters remain clear even when stored option IDs are lowercase; no answer-key, translation-quality or subject-matter judgment was performed.

observedChecks.name: Formula appearance
observedChecks.observation: Vector E and tau, t much-greater-than/much-less-than tau in Chinese and English question 1 are legible. Chinese question 4 and observed English question 4 show 100%. Chinese question 5 shows 1 second, 3 and 2 coulombs and all A-unit options. Chinese question 13 shows 25 A, 2 hours, 3 x 10^-7 kg/C, 8.9 x 10^3 kg/m^3, 0.2 m^2, 100%, m/h, approximation symbols and all option exponents. Chinese question 14 shows 500/5000 V, |e|, m_e, -19/-31 exponents and all speed-pair units/exponents. No visible raw TeX delimiters, rendering error labels or formula collision. Formula correctness was not reviewed.

observedChecks.name: Checkbox and radio appearance
observedChecks.observation: All 74 observed option controls have visible empty outlines: square checkboxes for the observed multiple-choice groups, circular radio controls for the observed single-choice groups. Controls are separated from their labels and align with option starts. No overlapping, missing or corrupt control is visible within the assigned scope. Functionality and native identity were not rechecked.

observedChecks.name: Missing or blank content
observedChecks.observation: Every tile contains expected text. Complete observed question groups have all expected stems/options, with no empty media block or content gap. Visible-only inputs contain no figure references. White spacing after the final Chinese option is ordinary sheet padding, not a missing question. Unseen English content remains HOLD.

observedChecks.name: Overlays, overlap and cutoff
observedChecks.observation: No modal, loading overlay, text/control overlap or divider crossing text is visible. Prose wraps inside the sheet. Formula baselines and superscripts remain readable. Deliberate top/bottom crop seams are separately accounted for below, not classified as product clipping.

observedChecks.name: Horizontal sheet boundaries
observedChecks.observation: Assigned crops show both sheet-side margins; titles, question numbers, option controls, prose and formulas stay within them. No observed horizontal truncation, overflow or text touching the image's lateral boundary. No claim about the unobserved app shell or pixels outside the crop.
